info.flavor: Advanced climate-control technology, originally developed for life support systems in Makaptan's most extreme environments, is the basis for the Thermostat archetype. Remote-effect liturgicode allows the Thermostat to effectively control other mechs' reactor temperatures in apparent violation of the laws of thermodynamics. Once a rarity outside of the Kahilwayan system, Thermostat chassis are gaining popularity across Union space, much to the chagrin of Harrison Armory designers.
info.tactics: Thermostats manipulate Heat – both their own and that of other mechs – to fuel powerful systems. They can punish Danger Zone-abusing enemies by either overloading them with Heat or sapping it away. Thermostats themselves achieve peak performance and durability in the Danger Zone, but peppering them with repeated attacks will force them out.
info.terse: Heat-manipulating controller that becomes stronger in the Danger Zone.

actions.name: Carnot Cycle
actions.detail:
Make a tech attack against a character within Sensors, automatically hitting allies. On a hit, choose one of the following:
  • Sap: The target clears {3/4/5} Heat.
  • Overload: The target takes {1/2/3} Heat immediately and a further 2 Heat after each quick action, full action, or reaction they take (even as a free action) until the end of their next turn.

add_special.detail: You take 2 Heat after each quick action, full action, or reaction you take (even as a free action).

actions.name: Heatsync
actions.trigger: A character within line of sight and Sensors takes Heat.
actions.detail: You take the same amount of Heat, then use Carnot Cycle against the triggering character. This reaction cannot trigger on your turn.

actions.name: Second Law
actions.detail: Make a tech attack against a character within Sensors, automatically hitting allies. On a hit, both you and the target set your Heat equal to half your current combined Heat.

name: Blackbody Barrier
effect: While the Thermostat is in the Danger Zone and not Exposed, it gains +1 Accuracy to all its tech attacks and Resistance to all damage and Burn. Whenever this trait reduces damage, the Thermostat clears 2 Heat.

active_effects.name: Blackbody Barrier
active_effects.condition: You are in the Danger Zone and not Exposed.
active_effects.detail: You gain +1 Accuracy to all tech attacks and Resistance to all damage and Burn. Whenever this trait reduces damage, clear 2 Heat.

actions.name: Thermal Shock
actions.detail: Make a tech attack against a character within Sensors. On a hit, they take 2 Heat and must pass a Systems save or become Shredded until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Maxwell's Demon
actions.trigger: A character within Sensors rolls an attack.
actions.detail: Increase or decrease the final roll by 2. A roll may not be modified more than once by any copy of Maxwell's Demon.

actions.name: First Law
actions.detail: Link with an allied character within Sensors. While Blackbody Barrier is active, it grants its Resistance to the linked character instead of you. You can only link with one character at a time, but may terminate the link as a quick action.

name: Ultraviolet Catastrophe
effect: After the Thermostat takes damage for the first time each round, the character within line of sight and Sensors with the most Heat must pass an Agility save or take Burn equal to half the Thermostat's Heat before it took damage. If multiple characters are tied, the Thermostat chooses one randomly.

active_effects.name: Ultraviolet Catastrophe
active_effects.detail: After you take damage for the first time each round, the character within line of sight and Sensors with the most Heat must pass an Agility save or take Burn equal to half your Heat before you took damage. If multiple characters are tied, choose one randomly.

actions.name: Third Law
actions.detail: Make a tech attack against a character within Sensors. On a hit, they gain the Thermostat's Mark, preventing them from clearing any amount of Heat by any means except overheating. Whenever the marked character ends their turn, they must pass a Systems check or take Energy damage equal to their Heat. Characters clear the Thermostat's Mark when they or an adjacent character pass a Systems save as a full action, or when you mark a different character.

add_special.detail: You cannot clear Heat by any means except overheating. At the end of your turn, you must pass a Systems check or take Energy damage equal to your Heat.

name: Paracausal Coolant [Veteran]
effect: Heatsync also triggers when a character within Sensors clears any amount of Heat, except by overheating. If Heatsync is triggered in this way, the Thermostat clears all Heat instead of taking Heat.
